sourceTitle: TCEA Module 8 — Project Management and Change Leadership

case.title: The portable classroom is still offline
case.facts: A fictional portable classroom remains offline after work stalled between facilities and IT. The principal receives assurances but no dependable completion date. Use only fictional or generalized details.

agenda.title: What would you do next?
agenda.prompt: A portable classroom is still offline. Facilities and IT each say they are waiting on the other. The principal has no dependable date. What should the project lead do next?

agenda.title: Define the work before expanding it
agenda.prompt: Write a one-sentence problem, one in-scope outcome, and one explicit exclusion.

agenda.title: Make ownership and dependencies visible
agenda.prompt: Who must act before the next milestone can happen? Name the owner, a dependency, and one early warning.

agenda.title: Communicate progress and check the change
agenda.prompt: What update restores accountability? What evidence shows that the classroom can actually use the service?

agenda.title: Build a small plan and test it with a neighbor
agenda.prompt: Draft the next decision, owner, dependency, update, and success evidence. Ask a neighbor to find one gap, then revise.

agenda.title: Choose the next conversation
agenda.prompt: Who will you talk with, what decision will you request, and what evidence will you bring?

participation: Think quietly, compare with a neighbor, check a model, and revise. Remain seated; a device is optional.
sourceNote: This 50-minute session practices selected planning decisions. It is not completion of the original four-hour module or a project-management certification.
planningFields: In scope and out of scope
